purpose: Live fixed parallel acquisition + final holistic verification (C+V); contemporaneous C/E controls.
selection: No accuracy-driven policy or threshold tuning in this experiment. DEV validates execution; freeze before TEST.
ordering: Sequential queries; randomly permuted C/C+V/E within each query, seed 2026.
contrasts: E versus C+V (controller package, not call-allocation-only causality)
C+V final versus its recorded pre-verification RRF (same live candidate evidence)
primary: strict R@1; paired query bootstrap 10000 draws, seed 2026; exact McNemar; exploratory, no multiplicity correction
failures: Preserve failures in denominators. Archive quota interruptions and stop; fresh attempt on explicit resume. Never silently replace results based on accuracy.
interpretation: Supplementary experiment on an already analyzed corpus, not a new independent held-out benchmark. Does not erase hosted-model drift or single-run variance limitations.
